extra.final_summary: Analyzed total revenue by region for Electronics. Fixed Region label variants (west/south/Wst/Suoth → West/South), cast 2 text-formatted prices to numeric, and excluded row 44 (Quantity = -5, violating the positive-quantity rule; it was Furniture so didn't affect Electronics totals). Result: West $10,880, North $7,560, East $5,880, South $4,200. Caveat: one Electronics row (row 48, Headset, $320) has a missing Region and is not attributed to any region.
